faithful_summary: Full Malay Wikipedia article: ReactOS is an open-source operating system developed by the ReactOS Foundation as a free alternative to Windows, intended to support Windows software and hardware and designed similarly to Windows 2000/XP. History: a FreeWin95 group was formed in 1996, stalled, then was restarted in late 1997 by Jason Filby around a Windows NT clone and formally renamed ReactOS in February 1998. Usage: as of version 0.3.17 the developers described it as alpha and not suitable as a daily-use operating system. System requirements list x86 or x86-64 compatible processors (Pentium-compatible or later), 64 MB RAM (256 MB recommended), a 350 MB IDE/SATA disk on the primary partition, a FAT16/FAT32 boot partition ('partisi bot utama'), 2 MB VGA adapter with VESA BIOS 2.0 or later, a CD-ROM drive, keyboard and USB or PS/2 compatible mouse.
